title: Understanding Codons and Amino Acids
text: Think about how codons are translated into amino acids. There are $$64$$ possible codons, but only $$20$$ amino acids. How might this relationship help reduce the dimensionality of your data?

title: Exploring N-grams
text: Consider using $$n-grams$$ to capture sequences of amino acids. How might using 3-grams of amino acids differ from using 3-grams of codons?

title: Choosing the Right Encoding
text: Which encoding strategy would result in the smallest dimensionality while still capturing the necessary information?

title: Dimensionality Considerations
text: When thinking about dimensionality, consider how many unique elements you are encoding. How does the number of amino acids compare to the number of codons?
